offering_description.value: Operates a B2B online marketplace for large-item merchandise such as furniture, outdoor products and home goods. It sells to resellers and retailers, and it buys and resells inventory and runs fulfillment and cross-border logistics for suppliers.

primary_products.value: furniture; outdoor and patio products; home appliances; home decor; fitness equipment

primary_services.value: marketplace hosting; warehousing and fulfillment; cross-border logistics

customer_segment.value: B2B: resellers, online sellers, retailers, hospitality and small businesses buying bulk merchandise

end_markets.value: furniture retail; e-commerce; home and garden; hospitality

revenue_model.value: product sales: merchandise bought from suppliers and resold to business buyers; service fees: fulfillment, logistics and marketplace services for third-party sellers

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys large-item merchandise from manufacturers and sells to resellers; software / platform: online B2B marketplace connecting suppliers with business buyers; service provider: takes in supplier inventory and provides warehousing and delivery to buyers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: furniture, outdoor products, home appliances and home decor sold through one B2B marketplace

distribution_channels.value: online: B2B marketplace website and app used by business buyers; direct sales: sales to larger resellers and enterprise accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: customs and import rules, product safety standards and data privacy rules for cross-border trade

notes: Exact product mix, revenue model split and company size are approximate and may have changed.
